text: Apps can filter, search, or sort messages in specific folders or across the user's entire mailbox
quote: Apps can conveniently [filter, search, or sort](query-parameters) messages in specific folders or the user's entire mailbox.

text: Apps can read and define a user's master list of categories
quote: Apps can access and [define a user's master list of categories](/en-us/graph/api/outlookuser-post-mastercategories).

text: Users can change the importance of a message, event, or task, or flag a message for follow-up
quote: Additionally, app users can change the importance of a message (or event or task), or flag a message for follow-up.

text: Inbox rules can automatically act on incoming messages, such as forwarding specific mail
quote: Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages

text: Mail tips give status information about a recipient while a message is still being composed
quote: Check [mail tips](/en-us/graph/api/resources/mailtips) while still composing a message to get useful status information about a recipient

text: The People API suggests the people most relevant to a user, based on communication and collaboration patterns
quote: The people API can suggest persons most relevant to a user, based on the user’s communication and collaboration patterns and business relationships.

text: The API can draft, read, reply to, forward, send, update, or delete messages
quote: Draft, read, reply, forward, send, update, or delete messages

text: Create, read, update, or delete notes, with optional inline image attachments
quote: Create, read, update, or delete notes with optional inline image attachments

text: A mailbox owner can delegate another user to send messages on their behalf
quote: Delegate another user to send messages on behalf of the mailbox owner

text: Add, get, or delete attachments on a message
quote: Add, get, or delete attachments of a message

text: Get or update a user's automatic reply, locale, time zone, and working hours settings
quote: Get or update a user's automatic reply, locale, time zone, or working hours

text: Query for messages and return the results in a search folder
quote: Query for messages and get them in a search folder

text: Synchronize messages or the mail folder hierarchy
quote: Synchronize messages or mail folder hierarchy

text: Trace messages through the Exchange Online organization
quote: Trace messages through the Exchange Online organization

text: Add custom app data to a message as Internet message headers
quote: Add custom app data as Internet message headers of a message

text: Access custom data stored in under-exposed Outlook MAPI properties
quote: Access custom data for under-exposed Outlook MAPI properties

text: Immutable IDs keep a message's ID the same for as long as it stays in the same mailbox
quote: You can choose to use [immutable IDs](/en-us/graph/outlook-immutable-id) to retain the same ID as long as the message remains in the same mailbox

text: Send mail with the request body in either JSON or MIME format
quote: Send the message specified in the request body using either JSON or MIME format.

text: Include a file attachment in the same sendMail call when using JSON format
quote: When using JSON format, you can include a [file attachment](resources/fileattachment?view=graph-rest-1.0) in the same **sendMail** action call.

text: Choose whether a sent message is saved to Sent Items
quote: Indicates whether to save the message in Sent Items.

text: Change notifications alert apps when a resource they track is created, updated, or deleted
quote: Change notifications enable applications to receive alerts when a Microsoft Graph resource they're interested in changes; that is, created, updated, or deleted.

text: Rich notifications include the data of the resource that changed
quote: **Rich notifications**: Change notifications that include the resource data of the object that changed.

text: OData query parameters control the behavior of GET requests
quote: Apps can control the behavior of GET requests by using [OData query parameters](/en-us/graph/query-parameters).

text: The API works from any language or platform that can send HTTP requests
quote: With the information in this guide, you can implement this in any language or platform capable of sending HTTP requests.

text: Extend the schema with custom properties and store typed data on Graph resources
quote: If appropriate, as an alternative, you can extend the schema, add custom properties, and store typed data in Microsoft Graph resources.

text: Well-known folder names such as Inbox, Drafts, SentItems, and DeletedItems identify default mail folders
quote: You can use well-known folder names such as `Inbox`, `Drafts`, `SentItems`, or `DeletedItems` to identify certain mail folders that exist by default for all users.

text: Attachments and S/MIME properties can be added to MIME content when sending
quote: Add any attachments and S/MIME properties to the MIME content.

text: Sample REST calls can be tried interactively in Graph Explorer
quote: Try out sample REST calls in the [Graph Explorer](https://developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer).

text: MailTips can identify a recipient's out-of-office status before sending.
quote: Get MailTips of other recipients' special status, such as out-of-office

text: Clients can create, renew, and delete change-notification subscriptions.
quote: Clients can create subscriptions, renew subscriptions, and delete subscriptions.

text: Custom data can be stored on individual resource instances and subsequently updated.
quote: If you need to add and subsequently update custom data, you can [store the data in individual resource instances](extensibility-overview).
